authority: Operational dispatch mirror only; live main/accepted evidence and canonical Drive governance override this file.

defaults.sourceDependencies: W02 policy/authority + W03 durability + W04-H accepted control core
defaults.mission: Classifier, Intelligence Router, L0-L5 reasoning, Confidence Engine, strategy registry, bounded agent runtime, bounded inspect/repair loop and routing evals with zero authority elevation.
sources: Legacy Manus/Aurora and TOCA model/decision references as reference-only

tasks.title: W05-00 Coordination / Intelligence Boundaries
actions: Freeze Intelligence vs Authority boundaries and W04/W06/W07 interfaces.
Run over-agentification gate before defining workers/agents.
Define routing benchmark/eval plan and cost/latency baselines.
tasks.forbidden: No policy/authority/executor implementation and no runtime feature code.

tasks.title: W05-A Task Complexity / Risk / Modality Classifier
actions: Classify task class, modality, complexity, reversibility and routing risk signals.
Use deterministic rules where possible with explicit UNKNOWN/confidence states.
Never transform classifier risk/confidence into permission.
tasks.forbidden: No authority decision and no router implementation.

tasks.title: W05-C ReasoningLevel L0-L5 Resolver
actions: Define L0-L5 reasoning semantics and deterministic selection conditions.
Respect latency/cost/reasoning budget and bounded escalation/de-escalation.
Reasoning level never elevates permission.
tasks.forbidden: No hidden authority and no W04 ExecutionBudget source-of-truth duplication.

tasks.title: W05-D Confidence Engine + Calibration Interface
actions: Define confidence decomposition/output contracts and uncertainty reasons.
Expose stable calibration interface for W18.
Use confidence to request verification/escalation, never authorize.
tasks.forbidden: No spend/write authority from confidence and no W18 adaptive promotion.

tasks.title: W05-E Strategy Registry
actions: Define model/specialist/computer-use/human strategy registry and compatibility metadata.
Support availability/freshness/fallback and model/provider abstraction.
Keep strategy registry distinct from W04 Capability Registry.
tasks.forbidden: No second capability registry and no executable authority metadata.

tasks.title: W05-F Generic Agent Runtime / Worker Pools / Leases
actions: Implement generic worker runtime only where agent semantics pass the over-agentification gate.
Support bounded pools, cancellation and lease/heartbeat/reclaim semantics.
Reuse W03 durable primitives when durability is required and prevent hidden tool authority.
tasks.forbidden: No god-object orchestrator, no duplicate durable workflow and no direct side effects.

tasks.title: W05-B Intelligence Router
actions: Route among deterministic/no-AI, model, specialist, computer-use and human strategies.
Use lowest-sufficient reasoning with explicit escalation on uncertainty/risk/conflict.
Consume W04 lane/budget/capability context and emit strategy selection evidence only.
tasks.forbidden: No direct tools/executor side effects and no control-core duplication.

tasks.title: W05-G Bounded Observe-Plan-Tool-Inspect-Repair-Validate Loop
actions: Implement bounded adaptive loop only for tasks needing iterative inspection/repair.
Validate planned tool choices against capabilities/executor boundaries.
Enforce iteration/time/model/tool/budget limits and persist structured strategy evidence without private chain-of-thought.
tasks.forbidden: No unbounded autonomous loop and no direct external execution.

tasks.title: W05-H Routing Benchmarks / Evals
actions: Benchmark deterministic, model, specialist and human routes using versioned fixtures.
Compare quality, latency, compute/cost and model/tool calls without invented measurements.
Prove quality-compatible routing can use less compute where possible and always zero authority elevation.
tasks.ownership: W05 integration/eval/benchmark tests and W05 evidence only
tasks.forbidden: No W18 adaptive production promotion and no new semantic runtime.
